body: Review of 1.15.0: the web sorted the overview with the browser's language-aware comparison, Android with SQLite NOCASE, which folds only A-Z — so Ä, É, Cyrillic, Japanese and emoji-led names landed in different places on each client. One algorithm, implemented twice and pinned by a shared case table: leading emoji and symbols are skipped, accents are ignored, case is ignored, ties broken by the full name and then the id.
title: one list order on both clients, the same for names starting with an emoji
